title: Failure of certificate split search
statement: Let $C,c,m$ be natural numbers. The bounded search that checks whether $n+(C+1)(n+1)^c=m$ for some $n\le m$ returns no result if and only if there is no natural number $n$ such that $n+C(n+1)^c=m$.
replaced: For natural numbers $C$, $c$ and $m$, the bounded search for a split position (which scans all $n \le m$ for a solution of $n + C\,(n+1)^c = m$) returns no result if and only if no natural number $n$ satisfies $n + C\,(n+1)^c = m$.
